name: multiinstance-jira-mcp

tools.name: jira_list_instances
tools.description: List every configured Jira instance (name, URL, deployment, auth method, mapped projects, session state) and the default instance. Call this first when unsure which instance to target.

tools.name: jira_whoami
tools.description: Verify connectivity and credentials by calling /myself. Without arguments it checks every configured instance in parallel.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_login
tools.description: Open a browser window so the user can sign in to a Jira instance that uses auth 'browser' (SSO/SAML/OIDC). Session cookies are stored per instance. If sign-in takes longer than waitSeconds, the window stays open and the login completes in the background — call jira_login again (or jira_whoami) to check.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

waitSeconds.description: How long this call waits for the login to finish (default 120).

force.description: Open the browser even if the current session still works.

tools.name: jira_logout
tools.description: Delete the stored browser-session cookies of an instance. With forgetBrowserProfile=true also wipes the dedicated browser profile, so the identity provider asks for credentials again.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_add_instance
tools.description: Register an additional Jira instance for this session (kept in memory; add it to your MCP config to make it permanent). Auth is inferred: email+token → basic (Jira Cloud API token), token only → bearer (Data Center PAT), nothing → browser SSO. Note: a token passed here is visible to the assistant; prefer configuring secrets in the MCP config.

url.description: Base URL, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net or https://jira.corp.local/jira

email.description: Account email (Cloud) or username (Data Center basic auth).

token.description: API token (Cloud) or personal access token (Data Center).

projects.description: Project keys hosted on this instance (enables routing).

replace.description: Overwrite an existing instance with the same name.

tools.name: jira_remove_instance
tools.description: Remove an instance from this session. Optionally also delete its stored browser session.

tools.name: jira_set_default_instance
tools.description: Choose the instance used when a call cannot be routed automatically. Omit name to clear it.

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Run a JQL query. Target one instance, a list of instances or all of them at once (allInstances=true) — results are grouped per instance and a failure on one instance does not hide the others.

jql.description: JQL, e.g. 'assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC'

nextPageToken.description: Cloud pagination token from a previous page.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

instances.description: Run against these instances and merge the results.

allInstances.description: Run against every configured instance and merge the results.

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Read an issue: summary, status, people, description as text, subtasks, links and latest comments. Set raw=true for the full Jira JSON.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

fields.description: With raw=true, limit to these fields.

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue. The description accepts light Markdown (headings, lists, **bold**, `code`, links, code fences) and is converted to the format the instance expects. The instance is routed by project key mapping or the 'instance' argument.

project.description: Project key. Defaults to the parent's project, the board's project or the instance defaultProject.

issueType.description: Issue type name (default 'Task'). Use 'Sub-task' with parent.

parent.description: Parent issue key (sub-tasks, or epics on team-managed projects).

boardId.description: Use the project of this agile board.

customFields.description: Extra raw Jira fields, e.g. {"customfield_10016": 5}. Values are sent as-is.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_update_issue
tools.description: Update fields of an issue. Only the provided fields change. Use jira_transition_issue to change status and jira_assign_issue to change assignee.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

dueDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string to clear.

customFields.description: Extra raw Jira fields, e.g. {"customfield_10016": 5}. Values are sent as-is.

tools.name: jira_delete_issue
tools.description: Permanently delete an issue. Requires delete permission. Ask the user for confirmation first.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue. user accepts 'me', an email/display name, a Cloud accountId or a Data Center username. Use 'none' to unassign.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_get_transitions
tools.description: List the workflow transitions currently available for an issue.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_transition_issue
tools.description: Move an issue through its workflow. 'transition' may be a transition id, a transition name or the target status name.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

comment.description: Optional comment added with the transition.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_get_comments
tools.description: Read the most recent comments of an issue as plain text.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue (light Markdown supported).

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_list_projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the account. Supports several instances at once (instances / allInstances).

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

instances.description: Run against these instances and merge the results.

tools.name: jira_list_boards
tools.description: List Jira Software boards (Scrum/Kanban), optionally filtered by project or name.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_list_sprints
tools.description: List sprints of a Scrum board.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_list_issue_types
tools.description: List issue types, globally or those available in a project.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_list_statuses
tools.description: List workflow statuses, globally or per issue type for a project.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_search_users
tools.description: Find users by name/email. With projectKey, only users assignable in that project are returned.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_add_attachment
tools.description: Attach a file to an issue, either downloaded from a public URL or read from a local path on the machine running this server.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

filePath.description: Absolute path of a local file.

instance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

tools.name: jira_copy_issue
tools.description: Copy an issue (summary, description, labels, optionally priority and comments) from one Jira instance to a project on another instance — or the same one. Adds cross-reference comments when linkBack is true.

issue.description: Issue key ('ABC-123'), instance-prefixed key ('work:ABC-123') or full browse URL ('https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ABC-123').

sourceInstance.description: Jira instance name (see jira_list_instances). Optional: calls are routed automatically by 'name:KEY' prefixes, issue URLs, project-key mapping, the default instance, or when only one instance exists.

targetProject.description: Project key on the target instance.

issueType.description: Issue type on the target (default: same name as the source).

copyPriority.description: Copy priority by name (default false; names often differ).

copyComments.description: Also copy comments as text (default false).

linkBack.description: Add a note with the counterpart URL on both issues (default true).

instructions:
This server connects to one or more Jira instances at the same time.
No instances are configured yet: use jira_add_instance.
Every tool accepts an optional 'instance'. Issue arguments also accept 'instance:KEY-1' or a full browse URL, which selects the instance automatically.
When the user's intent spans several Jira sites, use jira_search / jira_list_projects with allInstances=true.
If a tool reports a missing or expired browser session, call jira_login for that instance and ask the user to finish signing in.
Always confirm with the user before deleting issues.
